text: The month of practices aimed at harmonizing the first chakra has now come to an end. I hope that you practiced regularly and reaped the fruits in the form of a better sense of the voice of your body, a healthier lifestyle, useful habits, and perhaps even an improvement in health. And now I invite you not to lose the wave and continue the practices! For many years you have reinforced a certain way of thinking, values, habits, and psychological clichés, and now you have only begun to free yourself from all of this, step by step discovering who you really are. Continuing to move in this direction will undoubtedly give you deeper results.
